consequence.statement: A configuration setting `experimental.ruler.enable-api` is no longer honoured after upgrading to Loki 3.0.0; the setting must be moved to `ruler.enable-api`.
consequence.remediation: Replace `experimental.ruler.enable-api` with `ruler.enable-api` in the Loki configuration file (and in loki.config / loki.structuredConfig when installed via the Helm chart) before upgrading to 3.0.0.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the deprecated configuration option `experimental.ruler.enable-api`; `ruler.enable-api` must be used instead.
